scenes.title: Before the vote
scenes.caption: Vihaan prepares a fictional display-card repair classifier. Predictions happen before the inspector opens it. Aditi lays out fields beside that timestamp, asking which measurements could actually reach the model at that moment.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: An impossible shortcut
scenes.caption: The proposed table includes repair_completed, entered after inspection. It nearly reveals the answer, but cannot exist at prediction time. The impressive classroom score depends on unavailable information, so Aditi removes the field before interpreting performance.

scenes.dialogue: Future information cannot be an input.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Two photographs, one card
scenes.caption: Another shortcut appears when photographs of the same display card land in different partitions. Cropping or changing a filename does not create an independent example. Vihaan groups related photographs before choosing which partition receives each whole group.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Repair the design
scenes.caption: Choose the repair that removes the late field and keeps duplicate groups together. Moving only the most obvious duplicate leaves related crops exposed. Aditi also names validation as the visible pack used to compare development choices during this exercise.
scenes.speech: Choose the repair that removes the late field and keeps duplicate groups together. Moving only the most obvious duplicate leaves related crops exposed. Aditi also names validation as the visible pack used to compare development choices during this exercise.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Whole groups travel together
scenes.caption: Groups Cedar, Birch and Maple each have related photographs. Their complete assignments are training, validation and reserved evaluation respectively. Removing the shortcut and respecting groups makes the exercise more credible, although these changes alone do not guarantee useful future predictions.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Leave the envelope closed
scenes.caption: After training and validation tuning, Vihaan freezes the complete method. Only then may a responsible reviewer open fresh evaluation cases. Repeatedly inspecting that envelope would turn it into development evidence, requiring another untouched pack for an independent final check.
